newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Hartford Financial Q2 net rises. [CORRECTED 14:20 gmt]
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Hartford Financial Q2 net rises. [CORRECTED 14:20 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects company name from Hartford Life Inc and replaces results table).
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q2 1997 net includes a $368 million equity gain from the initial public offering of 18.6 percent of the company's Hartford Life Inc subsidiary's common stock.
Excluding the IPO equity gain, second quarter net income was $206 million, or $1.75 a share compared with $143 million, or $1.22 a share a year ago.
Q2 1997 core earnings, which exclude the IPO equity gain and net realized capital gains, rose to $182 million, or $1.54 a share, compared with $127 million, or $1.08 a share, a year ago.
Excluding catastrophes, core earnings for the second quarter were $185 million, or $1.57 a share, compared with $157 million, or $1.34 a share a year ago.
For the first six months, net income, excluding the IPO equity gain, was $410 million, or $3.48 a share, compared with $239 million, or $2.04 a share a year ago.
Core earnings for the first six months rose to $361 million, or $3.06 a share, compared with $211 million, or $1.80 a share a year ago.
The First Call consensus for second quarter core earnings was $1.50 a share.
